rows.title: The CPH number page follows Design Release 2.1: who is asked, its help and hint, a blank save, and where it goes
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 asks for a county parish holding (CPH) number for every live animal kept on a holding. In the live-animals set every commodity but horses (0101) and the pet code 01061900 (cats, dogs, ferrets and other live mammals) gets the question, built now over the commodities today's catalogue holds, so the same rule takes in pigs, sheep, poultry and the rest once the MDM catalogue holds them with no further change. The page cannot be opened for a consignment it does not apply to. Its help gains a second place to find the number, the hint loses its punctuation, the boxes stop browsers offering saved values, and a trader can save the page blank and move on, with the gap held at submission instead. The page is a step of the consignment addresses section: opened from that page and always returning to it. The plants frontend has no CPH number and is not changed. Every changed English string gets its Welsh machine draft in the same change.
acceptanceCriteria: A live-animals consignment holding cattle or fish is asked for a CPH number, and its consignment addresses page has a CPH section; one holding only horses, cats or dogs is not asked and its consignment addresses page has no CPH section (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-001, p9-002; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-106; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-110; trace:e2e p6-068, p6-070; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-025, p1-057; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p2-014, p2-025; p3-022)
Opening the CPH number page for a consignment the question does not apply to sends the trader to the consignment addresses page (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-001; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-106)

The CPH help's second paragraph reads 'You can find your CPH number on documents from the Animal and Plant Health Agency (APHA) or by checking your holding details on GOV.UK.', with 'checking your holding details on GOV.UK' a link to https://www.gov.uk/guidance/get-a-county-parish-holding-cph-number (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-009; trace:animals-fit p13-018; trace:e2e p6-084)

The CPH question's hint reads 'For example 12/345/6789', with no comma and no full stop, and still describes the whole group of three boxes (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-010; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p13-119; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-040; trace:animals-fit p13-007)
Each of the three CPH boxes turns browser autocomplete off and carries the pattern [0-9]* alongside the numeric input mode (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-012; trace:animals-fit p13-014)

Saving the CPH page with all three boxes empty shows no error: any saved CPH number is cleared, the trader returns to the consignment addresses page, the CPH section there stays incomplete, and the notification cannot be submitted until a number is added (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-014, p9-015, p9-004, p8-135)

The CPH page's back link goes to the consignment addresses page however the page was reached (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-021; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p13-117; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-043; trace:e2e p6-078)

'Save and continue' with a valid CPH number saves it and returns to the consignment addresses page, never on to the contact address page or the notification overview (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-018; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-045; trace:e2e p6-074; trace:animals-fit p13-050)

With the Welsh language chosen, the changed help paragraph and hint show in Welsh, marked as a machine draft that must not ship without Welsh Language Standards sign-off (repo:frontend p10-050, p10-051, p10-052, p10-053)

rows.title: The consignment addresses page shows the CPH number as 12/345/6789 and continues to the contact address
rows.detail: On the consignment addresses page the empty CPH row's bare 'Add' becomes the link 'Add a CPH number', and a saved number reads in the slashed county/parish/holding form traders know, on that page and on the review page. In the journey's first pass, 'Save and continue' on the addresses page moves on to the contact address page whether or not the CPH number applies: the CPH page is one of the addresses page's sections, reached from its own link, not a step after it. Opened from its overview task, the addresses page returns to the overview instead, as every overview-opened page now does.
acceptanceCriteria: Before a CPH number is saved, the consignment addresses page's 'County parish holding (CPH) number' section, after the place of destination, offers the link 'Add a CPH number' to the CPH page (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-003; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p12-135; trace:e2e p6-073)

A saved CPH number shows on the consignment addresses page as '12/345/6789', with a 'Change' link to the CPH page (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-004; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p12-138; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-045; trace:e2e p6-075, p6-076)
The review page shows the saved CPH number as '12/345/6789', with a 'Change' link to the CPH page (trace:prototype-dr2-1 p13-120; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-109, p4-037; trace:animals-fit p13-051)

In the journey's first pass, 'Save and continue' on the consignment addresses page goes to the contact address page, for a consignment asked for a CPH number and for one that is not (trace:prototype-dr2-1 p13-121, p12-144; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-196, p1-197)
Opened from its overview task, the consignment addresses page's 'Save and continue' returns to the overview and does not go on to the CPH number page (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-196, p1-198)
Reopening the CPH page after saving '12/345/6789' shows 12, 345 and 6789 in its three boxes (repo:frontend p10-038, p10-039)
With the Welsh language chosen, the 'Add a CPH number' link shows in Welsh, marked as a machine draft that must not ship without Welsh Language Standards sign-off (repo:frontend p10-050)

rows.title: With JavaScript, the CPH boxes keep out non-digits and one paste fills all three, if design keeps it
rows.detail: Traders often copy the whole CPH number from an APHA document. The prototype's script drops anything that is not a digit as it is typed and spreads a pasted number across the boxes. The 2026-10-09 afternoon ruling holds this for design question 7: the CPH page is built without new JavaScript and keeps today's server checks, and this increment is built as design answers, or dropped if design drops it.
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript, typing a letter, space or slash into a CPH box leaves it out, and County, Parish and Holding stop taking digits at 2, 3 and 4 (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-011, p9-012)
With JavaScript, pasting '123456789' or '12/345/6789' into County fills County with 12, Parish with 345 and Holding with 6789 (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-012-m3)
With JavaScript, pasting '3456789' into Parish fills Parish with 345 and Holding with 6789, leaving County as it was (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-012-m3)
Filling a box does not move focus to the next box (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-012)
Without JavaScript, '12/345/6789' pasted into County stays there and saving it shows today's errors, starting with 'County must be 2 digits' (repo:frontend p10-033)
openQuestions: Design question 7 (CPH number JavaScript), in the waiting-on-design theme: design must say whether the CPH boxes drop non-digits as they are typed, whether a paste spreads across the three boxes, and whether one box taking '12/345/6789' replaces the three. Built as design says, or dropped if design drops it (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p1-044, p1-046, p1-048, p1-071, p1-072; c-288).
notes: Still blocked: req-711 and req-712 both carry blockedBy design question 7 (c-288). The criteria stay as what the row builds if design keeps the prototype's behaviour; rewrite them to design's answer when it comes. Its theme is waiting-on-design.
Depends on the CPH page row: it changes the same page's boxes, so it lands after their attributes change.
c-006: no automatic focus moves (req-713 out of scope). c-114/req-715: the server's per-part errors stay as the backstop.
It is the first client script on this page and needs its own bundle entry and its own with- and without-JavaScript proof.

rows.title: A permanent address page for cats and dogs, with one card per animal and a same-as-destination choice
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 asks for each pet's permanent address on its own page in the consignment parties section, opened from the consignment addresses page, instead of inside the animal identification form. Cats, dogs and ferrets need one; other live mammals, which share their commodity code 01061900, do not. It is built now for cats and dogs over today's catalogue, and the same rule takes in ferrets once the catalogue holds them. The page has a card for each animal that needs one, showing the identifiers already given, and asks for each whether the animal lives at the place of destination or at a new address, revealing the address fields only when a new address is chosen. Each animal's choice and address are stored with the notification, every field in its own place, and a trader can save what they know and come back.
acceptanceCriteria: A consignment with cats or dogs has a 'Permanent address' section on the consignment addresses page explaining 'A permanent address is where an animal:' with the bullets 'will permanently reside' and 'can be checked by the Animal and Plant Health Agency (APHA)', and the link 'Add a permanent address' to the permanent address page; for cats alone there is no CPH section (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-023, p9-025; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-085, p7-106; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-081; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p2-014, p2-015)

A consignment of cattle, horses or fish has no permanent address section, and opening the permanent address page for it sends the trader to the consignment addresses page (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-023, p9-024; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-109; document:dr1-parity-backlog p6-012, p6-015)

The permanent address page has the caption 'Consignment parties', the heading 'Permanent address', the browser title 'Permanent address - Import notification service - GOV.UK' and a back link to the consignment addresses page (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-021, p9-032, p9-033; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p13-109, p13-110; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-082, p3-108)
The animal identification page no longer asks for any address field (document:dr1-parity-backlog p6-058; trace:e2e p6-028)

The page shows one card for each animal that needs a permanent address, as many as were entered for each species, headed with the scientific name and a running number such as 'Felis catus 1'; species that do not need one get no card (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-037, p9-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-091, p13-111; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-084)

Each card shows the animal's entered identifiers in inset text as 'label: value', such as 'Microchip: MICROCHIP-1', leaving out blank ones, and shows no inset when none are entered (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-039; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p13-111)

Each card asks 'Select an address' with the options 'Same as the place of destination (POD)' and 'Enter a new address', neither chosen when the page first opens; once a place of destination is given, the first option's hint is that address on one line, such as 'Riverside Holding Facility, East Farm Road, Leeds, LS25 3EB, United Kingdom' (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-040, p9-041, p9-042; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-092, p7-094, p7-095, p13-112; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-085)

'Enter a new address' has the hint 'This is where they will stay after spending 48 hours at the place of destination.', and choosing it reveals that animal's own address fields inside its card, with 'Email address' before 'Phone number' (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-042, p9-043, p9-050, p9-051; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-093, p7-097, p7-098, p13-113; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-086, p3-090)

The page ends with the 'Save and continue' button alone, which saves and returns to the consignment addresses page (document:dr1-parity-notes p1-055, p1-056, p1-058; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-104; prototype:dr2-1-source p9-077)

An animal saved as 'Same as the place of destination (POD)' has the place of destination's name, address, country, email and phone as its permanent address on the review page, and reopening the permanent address page shows that option selected (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-067, p9-068; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p13-115; prototype:dr2-1-specs p4-039)

A new address saved with a county and no address line 2 reopens with 'Enter a new address' selected, each value in its own field: the county in 'County', the town in 'Town or city' and the postcode in 'Postcode or Zip code', with country United Kingdom (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 p1-010; prototype:dr2-1-source p9-068; trace:e2e p6-032)

An animal left with no option chosen raises no error: the page saves the other animals and returns to the consignment addresses page, and the permanent address section stays incomplete, holding the notification back from submission, until every animal that needs one has an address with a name (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-062, p9-063, p9-074; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-102; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-089)

With the Welsh language chosen, every new string on the permanent address page and the addresses page's permanent address section shows in Welsh, marked as a machine draft that must not ship without Welsh Language Standards sign-off (repo:frontend p10-050, p10-083)

rows.title: The permanent address page checks each new address, names the animal in every error, and answers errors as an error page
rows.detail: With several animals on one page, the trader must be told which animal each error is about. A new address's name, first line, town, postcode, email and phone are required exactly when 'Enter a new address' is chosen, and the same-as-destination choice cannot be used before a place of destination exists. What the trader chose and typed is kept through an error and when the page is reopened, and the page explains what to do when no animals have been counted yet. Like the CPH and contact pages, its error state is titled 'Error: ' and answered with HTTP 400.
acceptanceCriteria: With 'Enter a new address' chosen and the fields left blank, saving shows 'Enter a name or organisation name', 'Enter address line 1', 'Enter a town or city', 'Enter a postcode or Zip code', 'Enter an email address' and 'Enter a phone number' on those fields; address line 2 and county are optional, and email, phone and postcode are checked only for being blank (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-054 to p9-061; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-101; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-105; trace:e2e p6-036 to p6-042)

Each address error in the error summary names its animal, such as 'Enter a name or organisation name for Felis catus 1' and 'Enter address line 1 for Felis catus 1', and links to the field; the message on the field itself leaves the animal out (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-054 to p9-059; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-100; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-091)

Choosing 'Same as the place of destination (POD)' before a place of destination is given shows 'Add a place of destination before you can continue' on that animal's radios and in an error summary titled 'There is a problem', linked to the radios (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-053, p9-053-m1; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-096; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-088)

When the page shows errors, every animal's chosen option stays selected and a chosen 'Enter a new address' stays open with what was typed; reopening the page later shows each animal's saved choice selected and its saved address filled in (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-064, p9-064-m1; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-100-m1; trace:e2e p6-043)

With no animals that need a permanent address counted, the page shows 'Add the number of animals on consignment details before you can continue.', with 'consignment details' linking to that page, in place of the cards; saving from there saves nothing and returns to the consignment addresses page (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-065, p9-066)

When the permanent address page shows errors, its browser title starts 'Error: ' and the page answers with HTTP status 400; the CPH number and contact address pages still do the same in their error states (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 p1-010; trace:animals-fit p13-005, p13-030, p12-052; repo:frontend p10-034, p10-071)

With the Welsh language chosen, every new error message and the no-animals message show in Welsh, marked as a machine draft that must not ship without Welsh Language Standards sign-off (repo:frontend p10-050)

rows.title: The contact address page follows Design Release 2.1 in live animals and plants
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1's contact page says whose address this is, puts the choice under its own 'Select an address' heading, shows each address without its country, requires a choice before moving on, and in the journey's first pass goes from there to the review page, its back link returning to the consignment addresses page. It drops today's 'Current contact address' card and its 'Edit details' link: the notification still stores the chosen contact as a copy of its address-book record, shown on the review page. The 2026-10-09 afternoon ruling carries the new intro and 'Select an address' heading to the high-risk plants consignment contact page too, and makes saving that page at the end of the plants opening run go on to plants' review page, even when the notification is incomplete.
acceptanceCriteria: Directly under the live-animals contact page's heading, body text reads 'This is the contact address of the person responsible for the consignment from when it enters Great Britain until authorities complete their checks.'; the hint 'Selecting a contact copies their name and address into this notification.' is gone (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-117; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-067, p12-140, p13-123; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-095; document:dr1-parity-backlog p7-023 to p7-027; trace:e2e p7-006)

Each live-animals address option is labelled with the address's name and hinted with its address lines joined by commas, without the country, such as '15 Union Street, Aberdeen, AB11 5BN' (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-122; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-070, p13-125; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-098; trace:e2e p7-010, p7-011)

The 2026-10-09 afternoon ruling (pm p3-043, p3-025) widens req-753, req-754 and req-766 to the plants consignment contact page, so this row builds in plantsfrontend as well; a requirement sits in one row, so the plants half cannot be its own row. The plants page keeps its own search, results and paging; only the intro and heading change here (the picker layout is req-1964, inc-086). Plants keeps its blank save (req-1967, exists; c-290), so the required-choice criterion is live-animals only.

Re-distil: the c-241 open question is gone. The 2026-10-09 ruling settled it as req-775 (exists): the contact edit route and its copy-only edit form stay, with no page linking to it until a later ruling names an entry point. This row removes the card and its 'Edit details' link and adds no new link.

The plants opening run's end on the review page is also req-1988, in inc-001 (journey-foundation), which owns plants' review rendering an incomplete notification; this row depends on inc-001 so the plants navigation criterion is observable when it lands.

Conflicts followed: c-120 (built now despite DR1's address-space hold), c-122 (a choice is required in live animals), c-123 (on to review in the first pass; back to addresses), c-124 (the notification's copy keeps the task complete when the record changes), c-125 (no card; the stored copy stays), c-204 (only the first pass goes on to review). The tests repo's contact-page and plants contact specs change to match.

Depends on inc-001 (the opening run ending on review), the permanent address row and the CPH row (the consignment addresses page the back link returns to, in its new form). The add-a-branch link and branch-only list are the next row.

rows.title: The contact address page offers only the trader's own branch addresses and adds a new branch through the address book
rows.detail: The contact is the trader's own branch responsible for the consignment in Great Britain, so the page lists only the organisation's branch addresses, not overseas consignors and other parties. When the right branch is missing, the page tells the trader how to add one: the link opens the address book ready to add a branch address, and on saving the address book returns the trader to the contact page with the new branch chosen and a success banner.
acceptanceCriteria: The live-animals contact page offers only the signed-in organisation's own branch addresses, newest added first; consignors, places of origin, consignees, importers, places of destination and transporters in the same address book are not offered (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-123; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p12-141, p13-125; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-097; document:dr1-parity-backlog p6-039 to p6-045; document:dr1-parity-notes p1-019, p1-020, p1-022, p1-023; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-119)

On the full stack, under 'Select an address' the page says 'If the correct address is not shown, add a new branch address, then return to this page.', with 'add a new branch address' as the link, and the 'Add a new address' link above the heading is gone; in stub mode, with no address book service, the page offers no way to add an address, as today (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-118; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-069, p12-141, p13-124; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-096; repo:frontend p10-067; trace:e2e p7-031, p8-075)

On the full stack, the link opens the address book's add-address page set to add a 'Branch' address (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-119, p8-120; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-079 to p7-082; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-102; trace:e2e p7-032, p7-080; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-092)

On the full stack, saving the new branch address returns the trader to the contact page, where the new address is in the list and selected, and the success banner '<name> address added to your address book' shows once and is gone on reload (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-121; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-083, p7-084)

With the Welsh language chosen, the add-a-branch sentence and the success banner show in Welsh, marked as a machine draft that must not ship without Welsh Language Standards sign-off (repo:frontend p10-084)
notes: Combines the branch-only list (req-760) with the add-a-branch path (req-755, req-756, req-757): both rest on address-book records carrying a type, and on the same round trip through the address book.

c-121: built once the address book's typed record lands, not blocked. Depends on the address-book rows for the 'Branch' type and the record's uses (inc-061, inc-070) and the journey-mode add page (inc-080). c-120: the sentence and add path are built now.

Decision kept: in stub mode (no INS address book, the fit environment) the page keeps today's behaviour of offering no add link (req-759, exists), so the add-a-branch criteria are written for the full stack only.
Live animals only: no ruling carries the branch-only list or the add-a-branch path to the plants contact page, which keeps listing the whole address book with no add link (req-1966, exists; c-291).
The INS front door's add page must accept the branch type from the handshake; the return already runs through the journey's address-return step by fulfilment id.
Depends on the contact page row (same page, same 'Select an address' structure the sentence sits under). Re-distil: unchanged.

rows.title: While amending, the contact, CPH and permanent address pages end with 'Save and return' and 'Save and continue'
rows.detail: While a notification is amended, the contact address, CPH number and permanent address pages offer 'Save and return' to the review, as every other amended page does, and a secondary 'Save and continue'; the plants consignment contact page takes the same two buttons. None of them carries the prototype's cancel-amend dialog: cancelling an amendment goes through the Amend bar's 'Cancel amend' to the cancel amendment confirmation page.
acceptanceCriteria: While a notification is being amended, the contact address, CPH number and permanent address pages each end with a primary 'Save and return' button to the review page and a secondary 'Save and continue' button, with no return-to-overview control and no cancel link (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-131, p9-020, p9-078; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p1-078, p3-028)

While a plants notification is being amended, the plants consignment contact page ends with the same 'Save and return' and 'Save and continue' buttons and no return-to-overview control or cancel link (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-028)

While amending, none of these pages opens a cancel-amend dialog; the Amend bar's 'Cancel amend' on each of them opens the cancel amendment confirmation page (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p1-078, p1-082, p1-084)
Outside an amend, the CPH number and permanent address pages end with the primary 'Save and continue' alone (document:dr1-parity-notes p1-055, p1-056)
notes: existingRow inc-097 merged req-770 with the journey-flow area's amend-ending requirements (req-1622, req-1624, c-210): the same shared journey buttons and one review. The combiner should keep that merge and inc-097's id; this draft carries only req-770's criteria.

Re-distil: req-770 now says the plants consignment contact page takes the same two buttons in the same increment, so the row gains plantsfrontend and a plants criterion. If plants has no amend mode on its stack when this lands, the combiner should make the row depend on the plants amend row (manage-notifications, plantsfrontend amend) so the criterion is observable.

c-289: no page in this area carries a cancel-amend dialog; cancelling goes through the Amend bar (inc-122, manage-notifications) to the cancel amendment confirmation page. The CPH page's dialog is part of the amend pop-ups' waiting-on-design increment.
Depends on the CPH page, permanent address page and contact page rows (each page must exist in its new form), on inc-004 (amend mode) and inc-122 (the Amend bar).

rows.title: The plants consignment contact page takes the party pickers' layout
rows.detail: Ruling sam-2026-10-09-pm brings the high-risk plants consignment contact page into the party pickers' layout in the same increment as the animals and plants consignor and place of destination pickers: the same search control, the results count under the 'Select an address' heading, the radios in a fieldset with a hidden legend, and each address read back on separate lines. It keeps its search over the whole address book, its five-a-page pagination and its 'Selected address' inset.
acceptanceCriteria: The high-risk plants consignment contact page takes the same picker layout: the search control in place of its 'Search' label, 'Name, address or country' hint and secondary 'Search' button; the results count under the 'Select an address' heading instead of in the table caption; the radios in a fieldset with a hidden legend; and each address read back on separate lines, with the country no longer in a column of its own (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-038; repo:plantsfrontend p7-052, p7-056, p7-057, p7-059, p7-089)

The high-risk plants consignment contact picker keeps its five-a-page pagination and 'Selected address' inset, following the default of c-292 (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-038; repo:plantsfrontend p7-062, p7-070)

With the Welsh language chosen, every new or changed string on the plants contact page shows in Welsh, marked as a machine draft that must not ship without Welsh Language Standards sign-off, and the page has no serious or critical accessibility violations (repo:plantsfrontend p7-090, p7-091)

openQuestions: c-292 (question, with a default the builder follows and says so): does the plants contact picker, which lists the whole address book, also drop its five-a-page pagination and 'Selected address' inset? Default: no; it keeps both and takes only the layout change (req-1964, req-1965).
notes: existingRow inc-086 (consignment-parties area's party picker layout) already holds req-1964: the requirement says it is built in the same increment as the consignor and place of destination pickers, which share the plants address-book picker. The combiner should keep it there and inc-086's id; this draft carries only req-1964's criteria, which inc-086 already has in substance.
req-1965 (the plants contact page's pagination and inset) is a question, not adopted, so it is not built; c-292's default keeps today's behaviour.

rows.title: The germinal products set has no CPH number or permanent address page
rows.detail: Germinal products are not kept on a holding and are not pets, so the germinal products set, copied from the live-animals addresses feature, must leave out the CPH number and permanent address sections and pages the live set has.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal products notification's consignment addresses page has no 'County parish holding (CPH) number' section and no 'Permanent address' section (prototype:dr2-1-source p9-002, p9-024; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-017, p1-018, p1-057)

Nothing in the germinal products set links to, asks for or serves a CPH number or an animal's permanent address: opening either page's address under a germinal products notification shows 'Page not found' (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-006, p1-014, p1-017, p1-018, p1-025)
notes: existingRow inc-181 (germinal products roles and addresses page and party pickers, germinal-products theme) already holds req-1832 and req-1833 with these two criteria: it is the same copied page, and building them apart would copy the page twice. The combiner should keep them there with inc-181's id and text.

Observable only once the germinal set's own mount, overview and addresses page exist; the copy waits for the live CPH and permanent address rows (inc-091, inc-054), so the live pages it leaves out are in their new form.
